A landing post — partly to test that the site builds, partly to lay out what I plan to use this space for.

## Why a blog

Most of what I write ends up in papers or internal documents. Both formats have constraints — papers are slow and narrow; internal docs disappear into Slack history. A blog covers the gap: notes that are too informal for a paper but worth keeping somewhere durable. Topics I expect to touch on:

- **Quantum computing.** Implementation notes on Qiskit / Cirq / ion-trap stacks, occasional dives into the theory side of my research (t-designs, ε-nets, gate compilation).
- **Software.** Whatever I happen to be building. Lately that includes some experimental work on procedural 3D character generation and on formal reasoning systems built on Answer Set Programming.
- **Meta.** Things about doing research and engineering — tooling, workflows, the occasional rant.

## Quick Quarto demo

Because this site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org), math, code, and figures all sit in the same document.

A bit of math, rendered server-side via MathJax:

$$
\big\| U - V \big\|_{\mathrm{op}} \;\leq\; \varepsilon
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
V \in \mathcal{N}_\varepsilon(U).
$$

Code blocks are syntax-highlighted and can run if you want — useful for embedding small Qiskit examples.

```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
qc.h(0)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.measure_all()
print(qc.draw())
```

::: {.callout-note}
The plan is to keep posts short. Anything that grows past ~2000 words probably wants to be a paper or a tech note rather than a blog entry.
:::
